utils/utils.js.purpose: Backport regex prompt replacement, including character rules and capture substitutions.

utils/imageInserter.js.purpose: Respect the content boundary for DOM and saved-text insertion, including fallback searches.

utils/database.js.purpose: Preserve and detect actual image/video MIME types; leave database identity and transactions unchanged.

utils/iframe/imagePreview.js.purpose: Use the actual cached media type in the existing preview.

utils/iframe/generation.js.purpose: Always release loading buttons after a response, including rendering errors and inaccessible iframes.

utils/promptReq.js.purpose: Distinguish automatic requests from manual demand dialogs.

utils/iframe/autoLLMClick.js.purpose: Mark automatic LLM requests explicitly instead of changing the manual preference.

utils/ui.js.purpose: Do not disable the saved manual-demand option when automatic LLM generation is enabled.

utils/pregen_manager.js.purpose: Concurrent pre-dispatch with cache deduplication; preserve cloud queued jobs and completion listeners across stream/chat resets.

utils/settings/stream_generate.js.purpose: Exclude complete/partial thinking blocks, fix generation-start events, and reset only pending work on stop/chat change.
